stats.notes: CDS C1 (fall 2025): 7,460 applied, 6,231 admitted, 1,685 enrolled; residency split in-state 7,260 / out-of-state 132 / international 68 applicants (60 admitted, 11 enrolled). Texas-based applicant pool: only 68 international applicants. The printed SAT composite row is inconsistent with the section scores, so no SAT total is stored; section and ACT percentiles are from C9 (45% of enrolled first-years submitted SAT, 5% ACT). The GPA-range table in C11 is garbled in the PDF text, so no GPA distribution is stored. No early decision or early action; admission is rolling with no closing date. Intl undergraduate count is the B2 nonresident total (82; 80 degree-seeking). The CDS student-to-faculty line is outdated (fall 2022), so the ratio is from College Navigator (20 to 1).

cds_test_policy.notes: CDS C8A: the SAT/ACT policy row is unreadable in the PDF text; the admissions site says test scores are not required.

cost.notes: CDS G1 (full year 2026-27, 12-credit minimum): tuition in-state $7,785, out-of-state and international $19,935; required fees $3,109; food and housing $10,544 (housing $6,754 + food $3,790); books $1,560. The G1/G5 tables are laid out unevenly in the PDF text, so values were matched by arithmetic (housing + food = $10,544). CDS H6: 45 nonresident undergraduates received institutional aid, average $17,442 (total $784,871).
